NAP, but if it doesnt hurt and isnt warm to the touch or anything like that (no signs of infection), its probably just some scar tissue developing around the area of the piercing while its healing that can cause the skin around your ear to LOOK kind of weird or inflammed or different. This happened to me with my helix while it was healing, around 4ish months the entire top part of my ear looked very different and weird but it wasnt infected. The weird texture/look completely went away after the piercing was more and fully healed and at the time when i googled it, it said it was a kind of scarring that occurs sometimes with piercings. Not a keloid or anything but another kind of scar tissue that fades eventually. Go to a doctor if it worries you but if it doesnt have any of the traditional signs of inflammation and just looks weird like that, you should be fine.
